pcs.pc_description: Apply empathy in to design a human-centred process to solve problems.

Use appropriate tools (e.g., interviews, mind map, empathy map, observations, etc.) to gain a deeper, personal understanding of the issues involved in order to capture and synthesize user insights and pain points.
Collaborate with diverse experts/ stakeholders to understand their areas of concern, and gauge their perspectives about the service/ product
Validate assumptions through empathy driven research and user feedback loops.

modules.module_title: Define – state the user needs and problems

pcs.pc_description: Gather and organise all project related observations/ findings from empathize stage
Analyse the observations/ findings to define the core problem(s) and then formulate the problem statement(s) in a human centred manner.
Bring clarity about the problem(s) that needs to be solved.

modules.module_title: Ideate – challenge assumptions and create ideas

pcs.pc_description: Look at the problem from multiple perspectives and ideate innovative solutions to the problem statement(s).
Generate as many ideas as possible at the start of the ideation stage.

Utilise different ideation techniques/ tools (such as Brainstorm, Brainwrite, Worst Possible Idea, SCAMPER – Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, Re-arrange/ Reverse, Timeboxing, Sketching & Dot Voting etc.)
Investigate and test ideas to choose the best ones in order to move forward, either to solve the problem or provide elements required to circumvent it.
Investigate the key solutions and develop prototypes (inexpensive versions or specific features) of the product/ service
Share and run the test of the prototypes within a focus group.
Identify the best possible solution for each of the problems identified during the first three stages of the design thinking process
Implement the chosen solutions within the prototypes and then test them one-by-one to investigate the same.
Accept, improve or reject the prototypes based on real users experiences.

modules.module_title: Test – try out the identified solutions

pcs.pc_description: Test the product/ service using the best solutions identified in the prototype stage.
Collect feedback from the users in a constructive manner to investigate the conditions of the use and the behaviours, thoughts and feelings of these users towards the end product.
Rule out alternative solutions by proceeding with further iterations, alterations and refinements.
Loop back to an appropriate previous stage in the process in case of one or more further problems are redefined in this stage.

modules.module_title: Effective execution and management of design projects

pcs.pc_description: Develop a comprehensive implementation plan detailing tasks, timelines, and resources.
Assign clear roles and responsibilities to team members involved in the implementation.
Conduct regular team meetings to monitor progress and address issues.
Utilize project management tools to track implementation activities.
Ensure that the design solution adheres to defined quality standards.
Collect feedback from stakeholders throughout the implementation process.
Conduct regular quality assurance checks to ensure compliance with design specifications.
Develop and follow a risk management plan to mitigate potential issues.
Document the implementation process thoroughly for future reference.
Promote sustainable practices by selecting eco-friendly materials and processes.

modules.module_title: Assessment of design impact and ethical considerations

pcs.pc_description: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the success of the design solution.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess project outcomes.
Gather and analyse user feedback to measure satisfaction and usability.
Compare pre-implementation and post- implementation data to evaluate impact.
Ensure user privacy and data security throughout the implementation and evaluation phases.
Obtain informed consent from participants in all user research and testing activities.
Address ethical considerations and potential biases in the design solution.
Implement design solutions that are inclusive and accessible to all users.
Engage with stakeholders transparently, providing regular updates and addressing concerns.
Document lessons learned and best practices to guide future projects
